effects.prompt: Put a non-attack action card from your graveyard on the bottom of your deck?

_comment:
'If you have played or created an aura this turn, Drowning Dire gains dominate.' / 'When Drowning Dire hits, you may put a non-attack action card from your graveyard on the bottom of your deck.' Runeblade Action - Attack; printed_keywords carries Dominate.

Dominate clause: release note says continuously checking ('if you create an aura while Drowning Dire is attacking, it would still gain dominate'), so it is a WHILE_STATIC, not a triggered ability. Shape = SOURCE_IS_ATTACK + real condition + GAIN keyword, which is what loader.conditional_keywords() requires to suppress the printed DB Dominate (_GRANTABLE_KEYWORDS includes 'dominate'); engine._recalculate_attack_power then strips the printed keyword and lets this ability re-grant it on every recalculation whenever the conditions hold (engine.py comment at the conditional_keywords call documents exactly this design). GAIN routes canonical_keyword('DOMINATE') -> 'Dominate' -> combat.grant_keyword, which is where play.py's dominate check reads. Condition: EVENT_THIS_TURN event 'play' qualifier 'Aura' - play.py records each of the card's types as markers, so playing any aura card writes did_this_turn:play:aura; event 'create' covers aura TOKENS (Runechant etc.) - create_token records subtypes/types per token. Both normalise via the same alnum-lowercase fold, so 'Aura' matches 'aura'.

GAP (minor): an aura that enters the arena by neither path - e.g. put there directly by an effect moving an existing aura card - records no marker and would not count. The two main paths (played from hand, created as a token) are covered.

Hit clause: MAY wraps MOVE_MATCHING. Target spec zone GRAVEYARD + controller SELF + amount 1 makes _compile_object_target ask which eligible card to take; filter CARD_IS_TYPE Action + CARD_IS_ATTACK value:false is the exact 'non-attack action card' pair used elsewhere in the corpus (is_attack is subtype-derived, so it works on graveyard cards). position 'bottom' is MOVE_MATCHING's default and put_object appends bottom-of-deck for it. I deviated from the triage list here: SEARCH_GRAVEYARD cannot express 'non-attack' (its filter_types matches types OR subtypes, so 'Action' offers attack actions too), and SELECT_FROM_REF/PUT_REF_BOTTOM would need a LOOK_AT first, whose zone vocabulary has no graveyard. Cosmetic only: the MAY prompt is offered even when the graveyard holds no eligible card; accepting it then moves nothing.
